note: What happens when a battle is lost. outcomes: one is drawn by the dice. fee: the share of the gold a helping hand asks. finders: the roles of people who may find the hero. In the pages {who} = who finds him, {place} = where he wakes, {fee} = gold paid, {gold} = gold lost, {n} = things taken from the bag.
fall: Your knees give way. The world goes dark.
hand: {who} finds you and carries you to {place}.
You wake rested and whole. The broth and the bed cost {fee} gp.
robbed: You wake in the dirt. Thieves took {gold} gp. Things gone from your bag: {n}.
{who} finds you there and brings you to {place}, whole again.
town: Strangers carry you to {place} and leave you on a bench.
You wake sore, at half strength. Your {gold} gp are gone.
